mapper.sql: payment_card_instrument_id, payment_card_credential_id, client_id, source_submission_id, customer_id, save_requested, payment_stored_card_id, expires_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT i.payment_card_instrument_id FROM t_payment_card_instrument i WHERE i.expires_at < #{expiredBefore,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_card_material_ticket t WHERE t.instrument_ref = CAST(i.payment_card_instrument_id AS CHAR)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_stored_card s WHERE s.source_card_instrument_id = i.payment_card_instrument_id) ORDER BY i.expires_at, i.payment_card_instrument_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_payment_card_instrument WHERE payment_card_instrument_id = #{paymentCardInstrumentId} AND expires_at < #{expiredBefore,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_card_material_ticket t WHERE t.instrument_ref = CAST(#{paymentCardInstrumentId} AS CHAR)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_stored_card s WHERE s.source_card_instrument_id = #{paymentCardInstrumentId})
